name: com.gamecore.gameplay.npc
description: Catalog row 4 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.3): NPCs. Kernel half: the npc plugin with the npc.state, behaviour, patrolIndex, mood, schedulePhase, targetX/Z (and logical posX/Z, yaw, timerMs) slots, the npc.setBehaviour/goTo/face/setMood/converse routes and the NpcArrived/NpcStateChanged/NpcUpdated events, and a DisableAutoCreation system that steps every NPC each step with the NpcLogicalMover (all NPCs move regardless of residency, at a reduced rate when their region is not resident) and applies schedule phases by step-derived world time. Presentation: NavMeshAgentBinder (resident views follow the logical pose through a NavMeshAgent, warped when they drift), NpcAnimatorBinder, NpcBubble (name/state bubble), all headless-safe. Talk: player.interact on a focused NPC asks IConversationStarter (P1.4) and holds the NPC in converse. Authoring: NpcDefinition, BehaviourDefinition, ScheduleDefinition, NpcRoster; Editor tools npc.addAt, npc.setPatrol, npc.setSchedule, npc.setBehaviour and the npc validator.
